description_en: You can call the DescribeDcdnUserResourcePackage operation to query information about all your resource plans, such as the total amount, remaining amount, effective time, expiration time, and status
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnUserResourcePackage查询您所有资源包信息，包括资源包总量、余量、生效时间、失效时间、状态等
name: DescribeDcdnUserResourcePackage

parameters.help_en:
The status of the resource plan. The default value is valid. Valid values:

valid: The resource plan is valid.

closed: The resource plan is closed.

exhaust: The resource plan is exhausted
parameters.help_zh:
资源包状态，默认值为valid。取值：

valid：有效。

closed：无效。

exhaust：耗尽
parameters.name: status

CommodityCode.description_en: The commodity code of the resource plan

CurrCapacity.description_en:
The remaining amount of the resource plan.

The unit for data transfer plans is byte.

The unit for request plans is count
CurrCapacity.description_zh:
资源包余量。

流量包单位：byte。

请求包单位：次

CurrCapacityBaseUnit.description_en: The base unit of the remaining capacity of the instance
CurrCapacityBaseUnit.description_zh: 实例当前剩余容量单位

CurrCapacityShowUnit.description_en: The display unit of the remaining capacity of the instance
CurrCapacityShowUnit.description_zh: 实例当前显示剩余容量单位

CurrCapacityShowValue.description_en: The display value of the remaining capacity of the instance
CurrCapacityShowValue.description_zh: 实例当前显示剩余容量

DisplayName.description_en: The name of the resource plan

EndTime.description_en: The expiration time. The time is in the \`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ\` format. The time is displayed in UTC and complies with the ISO 8601 standard
EndTime.description_zh: 失效时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

InitCapacity.description_en:
The total amount of the resource plan.

The unit for data transfer plans is byte.

The unit for request plans is count
InitCapacity.description_zh:
资源包总量。

流量包单位：byte。

请求包单位：次

InitCapacityBaseUnit.description_en: The base unit of the total capacity of the resource plan

InitCapacityShowUnit.description_en: The display unit of the total capacity of the resource plan

InitCapacityShowValue.description_en: The display value of the total capacity of the resource plan

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the resource plan

StartTime.description_en: The effective time. The time is in the \`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ\` format. The time is displayed in UTC and complies with the ISO 8601 standard
StartTime.description_zh: 生效时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

Status.description_en:
The status of the resource plan. Valid values:

valid: The resource plan is valid.

closed: The resource plan is closed.

exhaust: The resource plan is exhausted
Status.description_zh:
资源包状态。取值：

valid：有效。

closed：无效。

exhaust：耗尽
